items.title: Commencement
notes:
A meeting of City Council was held at 5:32 p.m. this date, chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

The meeting began with a Land Acknowledgement given by the Mayor.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
Mayoral Business and Updates - Mayor B. Vrbanovic
Recess and Reconvene
notes: The Special Council meeting then recessed at 5:41 p.m. and reconvened 8:06 p.m., chaired by Acting Mayor D. Chapman, with all members present except Mayor B. Vrbanovic and Councillors B. Ioannidis and A. Owodunni.

items.title: Arts and Entertainment – Ticketing Practices Overview (Position/procedure to be applied to negotiations and Solicitor Client Privilege - Section 239 (2) (f) and (k))
To confirm all actions and proceedings of the Special Council for March 2, 2026.
Adjournment
notes: On motion the meeting adjourned at 8:08 p.m.

motions.text: "That an in-camera meeting of City Council be held immediately following the special council meeting this date to consider to matters, one security of property and position/procedure to be applied to negotiations matter and one position/procedure to be applied to negotiations and solicitor client privilege matter as authorized by Sections 239 (2) (a) (f) and (k) of the Municipal Act, 2001, respectively."
motions.text_html: "That an in-camera meeting of City Council be held immediately following the special council meeting this date to consider to matters, one security of property and position/procedure to be applied to negotiations matter and one position/procedure to be applied to negotiations and solicitor client privilege matter as authorized by Sections 239 (2) (a) (f) and (k) of the Municipal Act, 2001, respectively."

motions.item_title: Arts and Entertainment – Ticketing Practices Overview (Position/procedure to be applied to negotiations and Solicitor Client Privilege - Section 239 (2) (f) and (k))
motions.text: "That staff be authorized to negotiate with Paciolan and Centre In The Square, the implementation of a ticketing platform in accordance with the terms and conditions discussed at the in-camera meeting of Council on March 2, 2026, and further, That the Chief Administrative Officer be authorized to execute said agreements with Paciolan and Centre In The Square; said agreements to be to the satisfaction the City Solicitor."
